name: 79603 · Abilene, TX
findings: ZIP 79603 (Abilene) has 61 nonprofit organizations. 26 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 23 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 79603 (Abilene) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 79603 (Abilene) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
